source:
@@U04189@@
Griffins are creatures of fable, what presumption to take on a real eagle!

@@U04191@@
They're making wide circles around each other, and now, at the same instant, they turn to attack, each aiming to tear at the other's heart and throat.

@@U04193@@
Look there! That hateful griffin’s had the worst of it! Torn and badly mauled, he lowers his lion’s tail and, sinking into the treetops, disappears.

@@U04195@@
As you have read the omen, so be it! I accept it, but not without amazement.

@@U04197@@
(Toward the right.)

@@U04198@@
A mighty series of assaults by us, Sire, has forced the enemy back and to the right, exposing and throwing its left into wild confusion. Our phalanx has now swung in that direction and with lightning speed spearheaded that weakened position. Both sides, equally matched, go at it now like waves in a storm-tossed sea. Magnificent! What more can be said! The victory is ours!

@@U04200@@
(On the lefi; to 浮士德.)

@@U04201@@
No! There! Over there! There’s something wrong. Our position’s in danger. I see no stones flying;
translation:
@@U04189@@
狮鹫是传说中的生物，与真正的老鹰较量是何等的大胆啊！

@@U04191@@
他们在彼此周围绕了一大圈，现在，在同一时刻，他们转向攻击，每个人的目标都是撕裂对方的心脏和喉咙。

@@U04193@@
看那儿！那个可恶的狮鹫遭遇了最糟糕的事情！他伤痕累累，放下狮子尾巴，沉入树梢，消失了。

@@U04195@@
既然你已经读到了预兆，那就这样吧！我接受了，但也不无惊讶。

@@U04197@@
（向右。）

@@U04198@@
陛下，我们发动的一系列猛烈攻击，迫使敌人向后右转，暴露了其左翼，使其陷入了疯狂的混乱。我们的方阵现在已经转向那个方向，并以闪电般的速度冲向那个薄弱的阵地。双方旗鼓相当，势均力敌，犹如惊涛骇浪中的波浪。壮丽！还能说什么！胜利是我们的！

@@U04200@@
（对lefi；对浮士德。）

@@U04201@@
不！那里！在那边！有问题。我们的处境岌岌可危。我没有看到石头飞扬；
